reported.title: Relay toggles far more than twice per 5 s window
reported.description: drive() at lines 44-48 recomputes D6 from `running && !held()` on every loop pass, so each bounce or release of D3 produces an extra LOW->HIGH->LOW edge on D6 with no debounce or edge limiting. The measured evidence shows D6 toggled 16 times in the 5000 ms window starting at 5.00 s (limit 2) during button bounce, and 12 times in the window starting at 5.00 s when the hold is released mid-run. Nothing in loop() (lines 59-74) counts or rate-limits D6 transitions, so the 2-toggle-per-5000 ms limit is never enforced. D6 toggled 16 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 5.00 s (limit 2), and 16 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

judge_input.spec:
- Mixer relay on D6; hold switch on D3 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Run the mixer (D6 HIGH) for 2000 ms out of every 5000 ms, the first run starting 5000 ms after power-up.
- Print `mix <n>` when each run starts, once per 5000 ms ±250 ms.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D6 LOW. The runs are still counted and printed.
- The mixer must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
